CustomField.description: Name (including namespace if applicable) of an Apex class that implements Iterable<Map<String, Object>>. Its iterator produces the source records to process. Use the map keys as the source field names on the Field Mapping step. This also is a way, other than External Objects, to process data retrieved from HTTP callouts to external web services. For example, you could query an external order system to learn the Salesforce opportunity IDs to apply updates to.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Fully qualified name of an Apex class that implements Iterable<Map<String, Object>>. Its iterator produces the source records to process, maybe even from HTTP callouts. Use the map keys as the source field names on the Field Mapping step.
CustomField.label: Source Apex Class
